def get_threads(conn, forum_id, sort="recent"):
    order = {"recent": "last_post DESC", "popular": "replies DESC", "oldest": "created ASC"}[sort]
    forum_id = int(forum_id)
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute(f"SELECT id, title, replies FROM threads WHERE forum_id = {forum_id} ORDER BY {order}")
    return [{"id": r[0], "title": r[1], "replies": r[2]} for r in cur.fetchall()]
